name: Move `rowbly-dev` to be an official skill
description: - The skill "rowbly-dev" is currently a skill within `.agents/skills` and is not available for users to install. Move this skill to the consumer `skills` folder so that users can install it. Make sure `rowbly skills install` list the skill as available.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Complexity 2 (supervisor only). Branch claude/row-21-rowbly-dev-official. Plan: move .agents/skills/rowbly-dev to skills/rowbly-dev (keep a tracked .agents symlink for repo use), add it to package.json files so `rowbly skills install` lists it, update AGENTS.md, README, user guide and setup reference.
